description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 20.12.2021 to 26.12.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations and compliance requirements, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is only to establish the authority making the regulatory determination, not to announce a personnel change or assign portfolio responsibilities. The core content is purely regulatory in nature.
